spec.title: Molis Auth 监控看板
spec.description: Auth 业务指标、前端体验与后端稳定性。环境单选，统一 schema 1。

spec.title: 核心 API 可用率
spec.description: 按 2xx、3xx 和 5xx 计算。排除探针、遥测和 4xx。

spec.expr:
1 - (((sum (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]http[.]request"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", route="route", method="method", status="status", error_code="error_code", duration_ms="duration_ms"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request"
| route=~"/api/(account|v1)/.+" | route!~"/api/(v1/(health|readiness)|account/telemetry)" | status=~"5[0-9]{2}"
| keep app_service
[$__range]))) or (vector(0))) / (sum (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]http[.]request"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", route="route", method="method", status="status", error_code="error_code", duration_ms="duration_ms"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request"
| route=~"/api/(account|v1)/.+" | route!~"/api/(v1/(health|readiness)|account/telemetry)" | status=~"[235][0-9]{2}"
| keep app_service
[$__range]))))

spec.title: 5xx 请求错误数
spec.description: 对外响应每个请求计一次。

spec.expr:
sum (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]http[.]request"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", route="route", method="method", status="status", error_code="error_code", duration_ms="duration_ms"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request"
| route=~"/api/(account|v1)/.+" | route!~"/api/(v1/(health|readiness)|account/telemetry)" | status=~"5[0-9]{2}"
| keep app_service
[$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: 全渠道登录成功率
spec.description: 基于落地的登录结果事件。OAuth 以平台处理提供方回调为准。

spec.expr:
((sum (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]login[.]result"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", method="method", outcome="outcome", error_code="error_code", new_user="new_user", entry="entry"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]login[.]result" | outcome="success"
| keep app_service
[$__range]))) or (vector(0))) / (sum (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]login[.]result"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", method="method", outcome="outcome", error_code="error_code", new_user="new_user", entry="entry"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]login[.]result"
| keep app_service
[$__range])))

((sum (count_over_time(

| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"

| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", outcome="outcome"

| app_event=~"auth[.]web[.]session" | outcome="clean"
| keep app_service
[$__range]))) or (vector(0))) / (sum (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]web[.]session"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"

| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]web[.]session"
| keep app_service
[$__range])))

spec.title: Cron 定时清理
spec.description: 近两小时最长一次清理运行时间。8 秒为维护预算。

spec.expr:
max_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]cleanup"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", duration_ms="duration_ms", stop_reason="stop_reason"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]cleanup"
| keep duration_ms | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [2h])

spec.description: 密码、邮箱验证码、短信验证码、Google 和 GitHub。登录成功率使用右轴。

spec.expr:
sum by (method) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]login[.]result"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", method="method", outcome="outcome", error_code="error_code", new_user="new_user", entry="entry"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]login[.]result" | method=~"${channel:raw}"
| keep method
[$__auto]))

((sum by (method) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]login[.]result"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", method="method", outcome="outcome", error_code="error_code", new_user="new_user", entry="entry"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]login[.]result" | method=~"${channel:raw}" | outcome="success"
| keep method
[$__auto]))) or (0 * (sum by (method) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]login[.]result"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", method="method", outcome="outcome", error_code="error_code", new_user="new_user", entry="entry"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]login[.]result" | method=~"${channel:raw}"
| keep method
[$__auto]))))) / (sum by (method) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]login[.]result"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", method="method", outcome="outcome", error_code="error_code", new_user="new_user", entry="entry"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]login[.]result" | method=~"${channel:raw}"
| keep method
[$__auto])))

spec.title: 新增注册 vs 老用户登录
spec.description: 仅使用已确认新用户状态的成功登录。入口可在序列标签中查看。

spec.expr:
sum by (category) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]login[.]result"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", method="method", outcome="outcome", error_code="error_code", new_user="new_user", entry="entry"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]login[.]result" | method=~"${channel:raw}" | outcome="success" | new_user=~"true|false"
| label_format category=`{{ if eq .new_user "true" }}新增注册{{ else }}老用户{{ end }} · {{ .entry }}`
| keep category
[$__range]))

{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]verification[.](sent|verified)"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", channel="channel", provider="provider", outcome="outcome"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]verification[.](sent|verified)" | app_event="auth.verification.sent"
| label_format category=`{{ .channel }} · {{ .provider }} · 发送尝试`
| keep category
[$__range]))

sum by (category) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]verification[.](sent|verified)"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", channel="channel", provider="provider", outcome="outcome"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]verification[.](sent|verified)" | app_event="auth.verification.sent" | outcome="success"
| label_format category=`{{ .channel }} · {{ .provider }} · 发送成功`

[$__range]))

sum by (category) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]verification[.](sent|verified)"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", channel="channel", provider="provider", outcome="outcome"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"

spec.title: 登录失败原因 Top 分布
spec.description: 包含身份校验、限流和提供方取消。

spec.expr:
topk(10, sum by (category) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]login[.]result"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", method="method", outcome="outcome", error_code="error_code", new_user="new_user", entry="entry"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]login[.]result" | method=~"${channel:raw}" | outcome="failed"
| label_format category=`{{ .error_code }}`
| keep category
[$__range])))

spec.title: 租户与团队协同活跃事件
spec.description: 新建租户、发出邀请、接受邀请、完成所有权转移和停启用。按实际提交计数。

spec.expr:
sum by (action) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]tenant[.]event"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", action="action", outcome="outcome"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]tenant[.]event" | outcome="success"
| keep action
[$__auto]))

spec.title: Core Web Vitals 页面加载性能（P75）
spec.description: 按页面看 TTFB、FCP、LCP、INP、CLS。CLS 无量纲，其他指标是毫秒。

spec.expr:
quantile_over_time(0.75,
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]web[.]vital"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", page="page", metric="metric", value="value"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]web[.]vital"
| page=~"${page:raw}"
| keep page, metric, value
| unwrap value | __error__=""
[$__range]) by (page, metric)

spec.title: 前端运行时异常与异步分包加载失败
spec.description: 按异常类型、页面、白名单异常名和 Worker 版本聚合。

spec.expr:
sum by (kind, view, error_name, release) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]web[.]error"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", kind="kind", view="view", release="release", error_name="name"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]web[.]error"
| keep kind, view, error_name, release
[$__auto]))

spec.title: AccountClient 浏览器侧接口异常与局部降级
spec.description: 按归一化接口、状态、错误码及降级状态查看次数和 P95。

spec.expr:
sum by (endpoint, status, error_code, degraded) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]web[.]api_issue"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", endpoint="endpoint", status="status", error_code="error_code", degraded="degraded", duration_ms="duration_ms"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]web[.]api_issue"
| keep endpoint, status, error_code, degraded
[$__range]))

quantile_over_time(0.95,
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]web[.]api_issue"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", endpoint="endpoint", status="status", error_code="error_code", degraded="degraded", duration_ms="duration_ms"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]web[.]api_issue"
| keep endpoint, status, error_code, degraded, duration_ms
| unwrap duration_ms | __error__=""
[$__range]) by (endpoint, status, error_code, degraded)

spec.title: 控制台 ReadOnlyCache 只读缓存命中率
spec.description: 按浏览器聚合真实 GET 读请求的命中和缺失。

spec.expr:
(sum(sum_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]web[.]cache"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", hits="hits", misses="misses", endpoint="endpoint"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]web[.]cache"
| keep hits | unwrap hits | __error__="" [30m]))) / ((sum(sum_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]web[.]cache"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", hits="hits", misses="misses", endpoint="endpoint"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]web[.]cache"
| keep hits | unwrap hits | __error__="" [30m]))) + (sum(sum_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]web[.]cache"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", hits="hits", misses="misses", endpoint="endpoint"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]web[.]cache"
| keep misses | unwrap misses | __error__="" [30m]))))

| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"

| app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request"
| route=~"/api/(account|v1)/.+" | route!~"/api/(v1/(health|readiness)|account/telemetry)"
| keep app_service
[5m]))

sum (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]http[.]request"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`

| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", route="route", method="method", status="status", error_code="error_code", duration_ms="duration_ms"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request"
| route=~"/api/(account|v1)/.+" | route!~"/api/(v1/(health|readiness)|account/telemetry)" | status=~"5[0-9]{2}"
| keep app_service
[5m])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Top 4xx / 5xx 错误码分布
spec.description: 取窗口内返回次数最多的状态与业务错误码组合。

spec.expr:
topk(10, sum by (category) (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]http[.]request"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`

spec.title: Cron 定时清理耗时与 8s 预算红线
spec.description: 维护耗时以毫秒计，失败明细按最近一小时计数。

spec.expr:
max_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]cleanup"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema", duration_ms="duration_ms", stop_reason="stop_reason"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]cleanup"
| keep duration_ms | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [10m])

sum (count_over_time(
{service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]cleanup[.]failure"
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-auth-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_schema="schema"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth" | app_env="${env:raw}" | app_schema="1"
| app_event=~"auth[.]cleanup[.]failure"
| keep app_service
[60m])) or vector(0)
